BYRIDER FRANCHISING PARTNERS, LLC | FRANCHISE GUIDE
Byrider combines used-vehicle sales, financing, and service in one vertically integrated model.
Vehicle sales create the customer relationship and begin the transaction.
Dealer-carried financing and collections extend the operating relationship beyond the sale.
The service operation supports vehicle ownership and connects back to the dealership experience.
Financial performance representations belong in Item 19 of the current FDD.
A DIFFERENT KIND OF AUTOMOTIVE FRANCHISE
This guide helps you understand the operating model, identify the questions that matter, and prepare for formal review of the current Franchise Disclosure Document.
Business leaders prepared for engaged ownership, sufficient capitalization, and a complex operating model.
Experienced dealer principals evaluating dealer-carried finance.
Finance, lending, or collections leaders with strong operating discipline.
Multi-unit owners who know how to build teams and execute systems.
Training supports the model, but no background or system guarantees results.
You own the decisions. You do not have to build every function from scratch.
